topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: When I found out my child has the same teacher I had years ago, my mind started racing back to those days. I remember the strict rules, the assignments that seemed impossible, and how I often felt like I was never quite good enough. Now, as I watch my little one pack their backpack, I can’t help but wonder if they’ll face the same challenges I did. I wish I could protect them from the tough moments, yet I know they need to learn and grow. It’s strange, feeling like I should have somehow changed the past to make their path smoother. As I tuck their favorite pencil into their case, I hope it brings them a bit of confidence I never had.
